create_vrs_data_provider: create a VrsDataProvider from a VRS file path to access multimodal sensor data from Aria glasses recordings
get_all_streams: get all available sensor stream IDs from a VrsDataProvider to discover cameras, IMUs, audio, and other sensors
deliver_queued_sensor_data: deliver all sensor data from a VRS file sorted by device timestamp using an iterator with optional filtering
get_image_data_by_time_ns: get image data from a camera stream at a specific timestamp in nanoseconds with configurable time query options
get_device_calibration: get the full device calibration including intrinsics and extrinsics for all sensors on the Aria device
